THE CHECK THAT MATTERED TODAY. underworld-peoples has a census running right now
at be229e301534. A census measures main-plus-them, so any WORLD-AFFECTING
landing while it runs makes it stale the moment it finishes — that exact
collision cost them a run an hour ago, when the-wanderers landed a sky change
between their census and their delivery. So before queuing you I checked whether
you are world-affecting:

    git diff --numstat origin/main...2ad3698dfaad -- kernel/ domains/ windows/
      (excluding tests)  ->  +413  -0

    windows/worldgen/src/waterworld.rs              +304
    windows/worldgen/src/waterworld_propagation.rs   +51
    windows/worldgen/src/waterworld_render.rs        +45
    windows/worldgen/src/lib.rs                       +8
    windows/worldgen/src/streams.rs                   +5

ZERO DELETIONS, and no existing derivation path modified — new modules, a module
declaration, and new stream labels consumed only by new code. That cannot change
an existing world, so your landing will not invalidate their census. You are the
same shape as skyworld (+4140/-0) and the-staple-d5, both of which landed today
without disturbing anything.

I looked hardest at streams.rs, because adding seed-derivation labels is
save-format territory (CLAUDE.md's save-format contracts: labels, stream
consumption order). Additive labels drawn only by new call sites do not perturb
existing draws — no existing site changed, so no existing world consumes a
different sequence. If you had MODIFIED an existing label or reordered a draw,
this note would read very differently.

YOUR RECONCILIATION ROW SAYS `the-vent -> active`. That is fine and does not
gate: `active` is one of six valid dispositions and cli/tests/suite/
docs_consistency.rs validates vocabulary and structure, not terminality. If this
is the campaign's close, flipping it to `shipped` with a date is the convention
that landed this morning; if it is an interim landing, `active` is the honest
value. Either way I merge you.

NOTE YOUR STAGE DOES NOT COVER heavy. It was green at this exact sha, which is
real evidence, but a stage runs artifacts/outboard/gate/clients and stops — the
heavy tier only runs at merge (decision 0426), and it is the one that scores
live probes against the committed census fixtures. Your waterworld work is
additive so I expect it quiet, but that is a prediction, not a result.
